description.value: Road 7 Country Fruit Market is a family-owned farm market in Oliver, BC, operated by the Dhaliwal family who have been farming the Okanagan Valley since the early 1980s. Opened formally in 2021, the market sells handpicked seasonal fruit and vegetables — cherries, strawberries, apricots, peaches, apples, pears, herbs — along with jams and cherry juice, all grown on their own orchards. The market also offers orchard tours and a cider club, making it a destination stop for cyclists exploring the South Okanagan.
